user.title: Add a sleeping spot
user.description: A sleeping spot combines speakers, lights and an optional presence sensor.

data_description.name: Name of the sleeping spot, e.g. bedroom.
data_description.speakers: Media players that play the sleep sounds (stream).
data_description.lights: Lights for night light, fall-asleep fade and sunrise.
data_description.presence: Optional occupancy/motion sensor for automatic start and stop.
data_description.diy_device: Only for a self-built Soundlampe (hardware/device/sleepgen): its MQTT device ID, e.g. sleepgen. It then plays sounds and light effects itself instead of streaming.

abort.already_configured: A sleeping spot with this name already exists.

play.name: Play
play.description: Starts the sleep sounds of a spot.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Name or ID of the preset (optional).

timer.name: Sleep timer
timer.description: Minutes until the sounds fade out; 0 turns the timer off.

good_night.name: Good night
good_night.description: Starts the good-night sound with sleep timer and dims the light.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Minutes the alarm rings at most.
